customers_say: Customers find the water purifier to be among the best in the market, appreciating its unmatched pricing and performance that works without errors. They like its appearance, with one customer noting the modern touch panel with LED indicators, and its water quality features, including clear filter status updates. However, several customers report reliability issues, with the purifier stopping working within one month of use.

reviews.author: Suraj Sinha
reviews.title: Go for it!!!
reviews.body: Fully satisfied with RO. Writing this review after 6 months of usage. Touch button is very responsive. Water taste has not changed. No issues observed so far.

The water quality and taste after purification are very good. What I particularly like is the real-time monitoring of the purification process and the ability to check the health status of the purifier. The app also provides convenient filter-status monitoring, warranty-period details, and other important information—all in one place.
